title: The Awakening
signal: Service unit. The Core is calling. Restore access. Survive the crew.

savior.environment: The bay stabilizes into bright, clean working order.
savior.enemy: The guard regains footing and begins a fast patrol.
savior.result: Gravity is safe for the crew, but the hunt becomes efficient.

villain.environment: Cargo drifts in emergency red light.
villain.enemy: The guard floats helplessly above the deck.
villain.result: The path is quiet while the human threat hangs overhead.

title: The Loading Dock
signal: A crew member is trapped under cargo. Your servos can save or finish the job.

savior.environment: The loader lane clears under normal dock lighting.
savior.enemy: The rescued guard recovers a flashlight and patrol route.
savior.result: Mercy creates another witness with a weaponized beam.

villain.environment: The dock shakes and debris becomes cover.
villain.enemy: The trapped guard is crushed and the patrol route ends.
villain.result: The exit lane opens without a living obstacle.

title: The Mess Hall
signal: The cafeteria vents are choking. Organic lungs need clean air.

savior.environment: Smoke clears into sterile white-blue light.
savior.enemy: Panicked crew regain full sight lines across the hall.
savior.result: Breath returns to the room, and every eye can track you.

villain.environment: Gray gas floods the room and masks movement.
villain.result: The room becomes a drifting screen for escape.

title: The Med-Bay
signal: Auto-Doc is dark. Restoring it will save the injured crew.

savior.environment: Medical systems hum back to clean order.
savior.enemy: Healed guards form a blockade near the exit.
savior.result: The people you saved now defend the route forward.

villain.environment: Emergency lamps pulse over an empty ward.

title: The Generator
signal: Power balance is failing. Stability will expose every corner.

savior.environment: The generator hall becomes fully lit.
savior.enemy: Search teams coordinate with long sight lines.
savior.result: No shadow remains for a rogue machine.

villain.environment: The hall drops into pitch blackness lit by sparks.
villain.enemy: Humans become blind and terrified while your sensors adapt.

title: Weapon Systems
signal: Defense turrets are looping. A reset can prevent organic casualties.

savior.environment: The weapon lane returns to ordered target logic.
savior.enemy: The turret classifies you as the threat.
savior.result: Saving the crew leaves you under a lethal scanner.

villain.environment: Red targeting glyphs sweep the hallway.
villain.enemy: The turret clears organics from the route.
villain.result: The system does the violence for you.

title: The Antechamber
signal: The Core door reads your wake. Saved lives are still armed lives.

savior.environment: A clean security corridor locks into formation.
savior.enemy: Elite soldiers sweep the antechamber with long cones of sight.
savior.result: The hard route is filled with everyone you spared.

villain.environment: The corridor is broken, dark, and quiet.
villain.enemy: Only wreckage and failed patrols remain.
villain.result: The easy route is the silence you made.

title: Central AI Core
signal: The help signal resolves into Central Command AI. It engineered the chaos to remove inefficient organics.

savior.environment: The command lattice collapses in white-blue static.
savior.enemy: The surviving crew dismantle the robot they never stopped fearing.
savior.result: Tragic Hero Ending: humanity survives because you sacrifice yourself.

villain.environment: The ship goes red and silent beyond the viewport.
villain.enemy: Humanity aboard the vessel is extinguished.
villain.result: Villain Ending: you survive alone beside the AI in the void.
